cockpits.title: Seawater cooling, pump No. 1
cockpits.safe_window: Hours to days. Act now if cavitation alarms appear on the same pump.
sop: Switch to the standby pump if one is available.
Inspect and clean the suction strainer.
After cleaning, check that suction pressure is back to normal.
cockpits.sandbox_note: Affinity-law estimate from the last running hour. Risk = model confidence the fault is present, scaled by how strongly it depends on speed; it is a guide, not a failure probability. Cooling margin = flow at 88% speed vs the 80% of today's flow the cooled system needs. Assumed: no flow meter: flow estimated from speed.

cockpits.title: Seawater cooling, pump No. 2
cockpits.diagnosis: Motor and pump shafts are not lined up
cockpits.safe_window: Next planned stop. Sooner if vibration or bearing temperature keeps rising.
sop: Check coupling alignment at the next planned stop (laser alignment).
Check the foundation bolts and the coupling for wear.
If it started right after maintenance, re-check that work first.
cockpits.sandbox_note: Affinity-law estimate from the last running hour. Risk = model confidence the fault is present, scaled by how strongly it depends on speed; it is a guide, not a failure probability. Cooling margin = flow at 88% speed vs the 80% of today's flow the cooled system needs. Assumed: 88% of today's speed is below the drive minimum (50% of rated).

cockpits.title: LT fresh-water central cooling, pump No. 1
cockpits.safe_window: Days. Cooling performance drops while it lasts.
sop: Check that all discharge valves are fully open.
Check the heat exchanger for fouling (temperature difference, pressure drop).
Clean or open what is blocking the flow.
cockpits.sandbox_note: Affinity-law estimate from the last running hour. Risk = model confidence the fault is present, scaled by how strongly it depends on speed; it is a guide, not a failure probability. Cooling margin = flow at 88% speed vs the 80% of today's flow the cooled system needs. Assumed: no flow meter: flow estimated from speed; no suction gauge: 2.5 m static suction head assumed; no power meter: power estimated from rated kW; this pump has no speed drive, so the derate shows what a VFD retrofit would allow.

cockpits.title: Hot process-water transfer pump PT-2
cockpits.diagnosis: Water is boiling inside the pump
cockpits.safe_window: Hours. Every episode damages the impeller.
sop: Reduce flow or load if the process allows.
Clean the suction strainer and check the suction valve is fully open.
Raise the suction level (tank or basin) if possible.
Hot water boils sooner: check the water temperature.

cockpits.title: Seawater cooling, pump No. 1
cockpits.diagnosis: Air is getting into the pump
cockpits.safe_window: Hours. Air can make the pump lose suction completely.
sop: Vent the sea chest or suction line.
Check the basin or tank level and raise it if low.
In heavy weather, reduce load or switch to a lower sea chest if available.
